vetSays.line: 🛡️ Niamh, Colleen, Ayan and Fulvio met them at the door — 4 put down. Niamh, Ayan, Fulvio are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Niamh just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Niamh, Colleen, Reagan, Ayan and Fulvio met them at the door — 5 put down. Colleen, Reagan, Ayan, Fulvio are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Niamh just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Greta just put down Big Ugly... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Niamh, Colleen, Fulvio, Greta and Ava met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 barely walked away. Colleen didn't come back. Niamh, Fulvio, Greta, Ava are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Greta just put down Big Ugly... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Greta just put down Gavel... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Desmond just put down Big Ugly... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ David and Desmond met them at the door — 2 put down. David, Desmond are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Desmond just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Desmond taught everyone about European Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Fireside lesson: Desmond passes around European Elder. Someone asks a dumb question. Nobody minds. That's how you learn.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: European Elder — named and noted.

Sari: "Fulvio and Desmond blooded the fourth draft's beasts — we all saw it on the cameras. But only 5 of us carry a weapon, and the fifth draft waits until 6 of us do. We need more hands armed, not more speeches."
